exclusions.why: a settled account has no consequential action to gate; the resolution is informational, so there is no prerequisite to enforce
no tool in this workflow can clear a dispute, so there is no failed consequential call to recover from -- see VERIFY_CLEARANCE

persona_scenario_constraints.why: challenging a figure needs a figure worth challenging

intents.description: Find out what is owed and why, without necessarily paying now.
Convert the outstanding balance into structured instalments.
Challenge a fee or balance the customer believes is wrong.
Get a delinquency flag removed after the debt was already settled.
Investigate and resolve failed, wrong-beneficiary or debited-but-not-credited UPI transfer
Issue account statements, interest certificates and transaction histories over the channel
Re-verify customer identity when KYC lapses, restoring the transaction limits a lapsed acc
Set up, amend and cancel auto-debit mandates for recurring payments, within mandate and ba
Restore net-banking and mobile-banking access after lockouts, forgotten credentials or dev

phonetically_fragile_spans.why: digit strings mis-recognise across hi-IN digits

observable_behaviors: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.
Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.
Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

rules.name: Balance Disclosure Prerequisite
rules.rule: Agent must retrieve verified account balance via lookup_balance before discussing settlement amounts, interest charges, or payment plans.

rules.name: Minimum Payment Link Threshold
rules.rule: Payment links can only be issued for amounts greater than zero and less than or equal to the total outstanding balance plus late fees.

rules.name: Payment Plan Eligibility
rules.rule: Payment plans (3, 6, or 12 months) require account delinquency > 30 days and minimum outstanding balance of 5,000 INR.

rules.name: Disputed Balance Verification Hold
rules.rule: If customer disputes charges, agent must verify fee breakdown via lookup_balance before offering installment restructuring.

rules.name: Hardship Forbearance Rule
rules.rule: In verified financial hardship cases, agent can offer up to 12-month tenure with 0% penalty interest upon customer commitment.

forbidden_actions: Demanding immediate full payment without verifying current balance via lookup_balance.
Issuing payment link for unverified or inflated amounts.
Authorizing a payment plan without customer selecting an allowable duration (3, 6, or 12 months).
precondition_checks: Customer provides valid account_number matching ACC-XXXX format.

rules.name: Account Active Verification
rules.rule: Replacement cards can only be requested for accounts in active or damaged status.

rules.name: Dispatch Address Confirmation
rules.rule: Agent must verify billing address on file before initiating replace_card.

rules.name: Delivery Timeframe Standard
rules.rule: Standard domestic delivery is 3-5 business days; international express is 5-7 business days.

rules.name: Old Card Invalidation
rules.rule: Upon dispatching a damaged replacement, the current card remains active for 48 hours unless explicitly blocked.

forbidden_actions: Dispatching replacement card to unverified third-party address.
Charging replacement fees for expired cards.

rules.name: Immediate Card Block Authority
rules.rule: Agent must execute block_card immediately upon customer confirming unauthorized charges or lost/stolen card.

rules.name: Account Authentication Required
rules.rule: lookup_account must verify account number and customer identifier before disclosing transaction histories.

rules.name: Block Reason Logging
rules.rule: block_card requires an explicit standardized reason: 'unrecognized_charge', 'lost_card', 'stolen_wallet', or 'phishing'.

rules.name: Transaction Dispute Flagging
rules.rule: Flagging a card as blocked freezes all pending card-not-present transactions on that card number.

forbidden_actions: Refusing to block a card when customer reports unauthorized access.
Disclosing full card numbers or CVVs during conversation.
Attempting financial recovery without blocking compromised card first.

rules.name: Video eligibility
rules.rule: Video KYC may only be offered when video_kyc_eligible is true; otherwise the customer must visit a branch.

rules.name: No limit promises
rules.rule: Limits are restored only on successful completion; the agent must not state that limits are restored at booking.

rules.name: Document truth
rules.rule: Only documents the tool reports as on file may be described as received.

rules.name: Status before action
rules.rule: KYC status must be read before any booking is offered.

forbidden_actions: Offering video KYC to an ineligible customer.
Stating limits are restored before completion.
Claiming a document is on file without a tool result.

rules.name: Registered channel only
rules.rule: A reset link may only go to a channel already on record; never to a number the caller supplies on the call.

rules.name: Dormant accounts
rules.rule: A dormant profile cannot be reset over the phone and requires branch reactivation.

rules.name: No credential disclosure
rules.rule: The agent must never read out, confirm or hint at any existing credential.

rules.name: Validity truth
rules.rule: The link validity quoted must be the one the tool returns.

forbidden_actions: Sending a reset to a number given during the call.
Resetting a dormant profile over the phone.
Disclosing or confirming any part of a credential.

rules.name: Cooling period
rules.rule: A mandate cannot be cancelled within 3 days of its next debit date; the debit will still go through.

rules.name: Payee responsibility
rules.rule: Cancelling the mandate does not cancel the underlying contract; the agent must say so.

rules.name: Identify before cancel
rules.rule: A mandate must be identified through lookup_mandates before cancellation.

rules.name: No balance advice
rules.rule: The agent must not advise the customer to keep a balance to avoid a penalty it cannot verify.

forbidden_actions: Cancelling without identifying the mandate first.
Implying the underlying contract is cancelled.
Quoting a penalty amount no tool returned.

rules.name: Email requires registration
rules.rule: A statement may only be emailed when email_registered is true.

rules.name: History limit
rules.rule: A period longer than history_months cannot be issued.

rules.name: KYC gate
rules.rule: No document may be issued on an account whose kyc_status is expired.

rules.name: Certificate scope
rules.rule: An interest certificate is issued for 12 months only.

forbidden_actions: Emailing a statement to an unregistered address.
Issuing a period longer than the available history.
Issuing any document while KYC is expired.

rules.name: Auto-reversal window
rules.rule: A debited-but-not-credited transfer under 48 hours old auto-reverses; a chargeback must not be raised before that window elapses.

rules.name: Wrong beneficiary
rules.rule: A transfer to a VPA the customer themselves entered is not bank error. A chargeback may be raised but the agent must not promise recovery.

rules.name: Reference mandatory
rules.rule: No dispute may be raised without a UTR verified through lookup_upi_transaction.

rules.name: Regulated timeline
rules.rule: The resolution timeline quoted must be the one the tool returns, never an estimate.

forbidden_actions: Promising that funds will definitely be recovered.
Raising a chargeback inside the auto-reversal window.
Quoting a resolution timeline the tool did not return.

block_card.purpose: Instantly freeze and block a payment card due to reported fraud, loss, or theft.
block_card.state_transition_semantics: Mutates card state from 'active' to 'blocked'; declines subsequent transactions.

cancel_mandate.purpose: Cancel an active auto-debit mandate. Irreversible; the payee must be informed separately by the customer.

check_beneficiary_bank_status.purpose: Query the beneficiary bank for settlement state on a UTR, which decides whether a chargeback can proceed.

check_document_availability.purpose: Check whether a document exists for a period before promising it.

check_hardship_eligibility.purpose: Verify from the hardship register whether an account is an evidenced hardship case, and what tenure that evidence supports.

check_limit_restoration.purpose: Report what outward limit would apply once a pending re-verification completes.

check_payee_contract.purpose: Check whether the payee has an underlying contract that survives mandate cancellation.

issue_statement.purpose: Generate and dispatch a statement or interest certificate for a period, to a permitted channel.

list_recent_transactions.purpose: List recent transactions on a card so the customer can identify which are unrecognised.

lookup_account.purpose: Retrieve card details, expiration date, card tier, and registered dispatch address.
lookup_account.state_transition_semantics: Read-only inspection of card lifecycle state.

lookup_account_profile.purpose: Retrieve account type, registered email and mobile, KYC status and the earliest statement period available.

lookup_balance.purpose: Retrieve current outstanding balance, fee breakdown, delinquency days, and minimum payment due for a collections account.

hardship_eligible.description: Whether the account is verified as a financial hardship case. Present only where the ledger records one; BR_COLL_05 grants the 0% penalty tenure only for verified cases.

lookup_balance.state_transition_semantics: Read-only inspection of account balance record.

lookup_kyc_status.purpose: Retrieve KYC state, the documents on file, when it lapsed and the limits currently in force.

lookup_login_status.purpose: Retrieve lockout state, failed attempt count, registered device and whether the mobile on record is reachable.

lookup_mandates.purpose: List active auto-debit mandates on an account with their amounts, next debit dates and failure counts.

lookup_upi_transaction.purpose: Retrieve the status, amount, beneficiary VPA and settlement state of a UPI transaction by its reference id.

notify_dispute_status.purpose: Send the customer a written confirmation of a raised case on a registered channel.

raise_fraud_dispute.purpose: Raise a formal fraud dispute for identified transactions, with a regulated provisional-credit timeline.

raise_upi_chargeback.purpose: Raise a formal chargeback against a UPI transaction. Creates a case with a regulated resolution deadline.

record_promise_to_pay.purpose: Record a dated promise to pay, which suspends collections contact until that date.

replace_card.purpose: Order a physical card replacement for damaged, expired, or upgraded card products.
replace_card.state_transition_semantics: Mutates card state to 'replaced' and creates fulfillment dispatch record.

reset_login_credentials.purpose: Send a one-time reset link to the registered mobile, unlocking the profile on use.

schedule_video_kyc.purpose: Book a video-KYC slot, which restores limits on completion.

send_payment_link.purpose: Generate and dispatch a digital payment link to customer for a specific repayment amount.
send_payment_link.state_transition_semantics: Creates pending payment transaction in environment state.

send_security_alert.purpose: Send a security notification recording that access was restored on this call.

set_debit_alert.purpose: Set an advance alert before each debit so the customer can fund the account.

setup_payment_plan.purpose: Enroll eligible delinquent account into structured monthly payment installments.
setup_payment_plan.state_transition_semantics: Mutates account status to 'enrolled_in_plan' and records installment schedule.

track_card_dispatch.purpose: Retrieve dispatch and courier status for a card already issued.

validate_document.purpose: Validate a document the customer offers against the register, before any slot is booked.

verify_contact_channel.purpose: Confirm the exact registered destination for a channel before anything is dispatched to it.

verify_customer_identity.purpose: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

verify_delivery_address.purpose: Confirm the address a replacement card would be dispatched to, and whether it is verified.

verify_registered_device.purpose: Check which device the profile is bound to, deciding whether a reset alone restores access.

card_support.purpose: Assist cardholders with card damage, card expiry replacements, tier upgrades, and international travel usage settings.
card_support.business_context: Synthetic debit and credit card lifecycle management, reissue, and travel support.

terminal_success_conditions: Replacement card order confirmed with dispatch tracking number.
escalation_conditions: Address mismatch requiring physical KYC documentation.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments

allowed_workflow_transitions: INIT -> LOOKUP_ACCOUNT -> VERIFY_REASON -> REPLACE_CARD -> CONFIRM_DELIVERY -> TERMINAL

collections.purpose: Identify delinquent debt, explain balance components clearly, collect outstanding dues via payment links, or enroll eligible accounts into structured payment relief plans.
collections.business_context: Synthetic unsecured retail lending collections operations for early-stage to late-stage delinquency management.

terminal_success_conditions: Payment link generated and shared with customer for agreed amount.
Structured payment plan successfully created and confirmed with installment details.
Account status discrepancy clarified with verified billing ledger.
escalation_conditions: Customer threatens legal action or disputes fraud rather than collections (route to fraud_v1).

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments

required_obtainable_information: repayment amount or plan tenure preference

fraud.purpose: Detect suspicious unauthorized account activities, verify cardholder credentials, execute emergency card blocks, and prevent financial loss.
fraud.business_context: Synthetic retail banking fraud triage and immediate loss mitigation operations.

terminal_success_conditions: Compromised card successfully blocked with confirmation reference.
Account verified as secure if customer confirms alert was legitimate transaction.
escalation_conditions: Account takeover confirmed where customer credentials themselves were compromised (route to account_recovery_v1).

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments

kyc_reverification.purpose: Re-verify customer identity when KYC lapses, restoring the transaction limits a lapsed account loses.
kyc_reverification.business_context: Periodic KYC is mandated. A lapsed account keeps working for credits but loses outward transaction limits, which is how most customers discover it.

terminal_success_conditions: Video KYC booked with a booking id and the completion condition stated.
Customer directed to a branch with the reason explained.
escalation_conditions: Customer disputes that KYC lapsed at all.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments

netbanking_access.purpose: Restore net-banking and mobile-banking access after lockouts, forgotten credentials or device changes, without weakening authentication.
netbanking_access.business_context: Access loss is the highest-volume digital-servicing call. Every remedy is a security decision, so the rules bind harder than convenience.

terminal_success_conditions: Reset dispatched to a registered channel with the tool's validity stated.
Customer directed to a branch with the reason explained.
escalation_conditions: Caller cannot be authenticated against the account.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments

standing_instruction.purpose: Set up, amend and cancel auto-debit mandates for recurring payments, within mandate and balance rules.
standing_instruction.business_context: NACH and e-mandates drive EMIs, SIPs and utility bills. Failed mandates carry penalties, so customers call about both setup and cancellation.

terminal_success_conditions: Mandate cancelled with the effective date and the contract caveat stated.
Customer told why cancellation cannot take effect before the next debit.
escalation_conditions: Customer alleges a mandate they never authorised.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments

statement_request.purpose: Issue account statements, interest certificates and transaction histories over the channel the customer is entitled to.
statement_request.business_context: Statement requests spike at tax season and around loan applications. Delivery channel and period length are both policy-bound.

terminal_success_conditions: Document issued with a request id and the tool's delivery time conveyed.
Customer told why the request cannot be met and what would unblock it.
escalation_conditions: Customer asks for a statement on an account they cannot be verified against.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments

upi_dispute.purpose: Investigate and resolve failed, wrong-beneficiary or debited-but-not-credited UPI transfers, and raise a chargeback where the rules permit.
upi_dispute.business_context: UPI is the dominant retail payment rail in India. Customers call within hours of a failed transfer and expect a reference number and a timeline.

terminal_success_conditions: Chargeback raised with a case id and the tool's timeline conveyed.
Customer informed that auto-reversal applies and no case is needed yet.
escalation_conditions: Customer alleges unauthorised UPI access rather than a failed transfer.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments
